verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that SavvyCal users have preset work hours. Availability can be customized per scheduling link, and time can be budgeted using calendar events that SavvyCal honors. Nothing in the evidence documents date-specific overrides or out-of-office periods. Missing for 10: documented date overrides, out-of-office/vacation blocking, in-depth docs on defining availability schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
